rationale: Check whether existing buyer-voice and commercial-family heuristics appear in disjoint source contexts that have different interpretations; never call overlap a confirmed false positive.

contexts.exact_title: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (September 2026)
contexts.meaning: job-seeking offer context; not software buyer demand by default
employer job vacancies, not automatically software-purchase demand
product demos and mixed projects, possible genuine needs; no blanket veto

limitations: Deliberately selected thread types, not a representative sample.
Same HN Algolia provider and same heuristic family; not cross-source validation.
Search metadata alone cannot verify a real buyer or willingness to pay.
No raw evidence and no human labels persisted; flagged overlaps are NOT proven mistakes.
The parameter only changes shadow review priority, never accepted demand counts.
September has not been used to evolve these context hypotheses; after this run it becomes development feedback, not untouched confirmation.
